note: Adapted from Maiti 2006; original in English; in Table 9 the antenna segment row of the alate of this species reads '-', while the text gives 16—19 segments, which is noted.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Alate head nearly circular, wider than long, sides slightly convex but weakly divergent anteriorly; fontanelle very small, slightly convex, almost central; antennae 16—19-segmented, segment 3 the smallest, segment 4 broad and about one and a half times the length of segment 3; postclypeus with a median line; pronotum anterior margin weakly concave without a median notch. Soldier head pear-shaped, the maximum width about 1.5 times the anterior width, sides converging anteriorly; fontanelle opening rather small, with a collar-like rim, turned outwards and backwards; antennae 14-segmented; labrum lanceolate, the tip pointed with a transparent end and two setae; mandibles long and narrow, gradually incurved to a fine tip.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head chestnut brown, the rest paler; wings smoky brown. Head sparsely hairy, pronotum and abdomen more densely hairy. Head nearly circular, wider than long, sides slightly convex but weakly divergent anteriorly; fontanelle very small, slightly convex, almost central; antennae 16—19-segmented, segment 3 the smallest, segment 4 broad and about one and a half times the length of segment 3; compound eyes fairly large; ocelli long oval, the distance to the compound eye about equal to their short diameter; postclypeus with a median line; labrum wider than long, the tip rounded. Pronotum narrower than the head, anterior margin weakly concave without a median notch, posterior margin nearly straight with a weak median concavity. Measurements (mm): body length with wings 11.90; body length without wings 6.00; head length to the lateral base of the mandible 0.96; head width including the eyes 1.14; postclypeus length 0.20, width 0.57; maximum eye diameter 0.30; maximum ocellus diameter 0.13, short diameter 0.08; eye—ocellus distance 0.03; pronotum length 0.61, width 0.96; forewing scale length 0.69; hindwing scale length 0.38.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head light brown, the rest paler. Head with a few erect hairs, pronotum and abdomen with more hairs. Head pear-shaped, the maximum width about 1.5 times the anterior width, sides converging anteriorly; fontanelle opening rather small, with a collar-like rim, turned outwards and backwards; antennae 14-segmented, segment 3 variable; labrum lanceolate, the tip pointed with a transparent end and two setae; mandibles long and narrow, gradually incurved to a fine tip. Postmentum broadly rod-like, with a few microchaetae anteriorly, widest in the anterior third and narrowest in the posterior third. Pronotum far wider than long, its length slightly more than half its width, anterior margin without a concavity, posterior margin nearly straight with a weak median concavity. Measurements (mm): head length to the lateral base of the mandible 1.17—1.32; maximum head width 0.93—0.99; anterior head width 0.58—0.62; head contraction index 0.62; head index 0.75—0.79; labrum length 0.26, width 0.19; mandible length 0.61—0.69; head—mandible index 0.52; postmentum midlength 0.73, maximum width 0.34, waist width 0.20—0.24; pronotum length 0.36—0.40, width 0.69—0.73; pronotum index 0.52—0.54; pronotum/head width index 0.73—0.74; antennae 14-segmented.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: The antenna segment number of the alate is blank in Table 9; the value 16—19 segments given in this section follows the text. In Table 9 several rows of this species other than the forewing (without scale) and the postclypeus are largely blank, and the rows with values were checked one by one and taken.
